name: Braided Glasses K-Fashion Portrait
image_purpose: lookbook line sheet and fashion campaign reference

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic close-up fashion portrait with braided hair, warm neutral styling, and refined Korean street-style editorial polish.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with thick dark hair in twin high artistic braids, loose strands and matte brown statement clips, brown cat-eye glasses, soft hazel eyes, natural dewy skin, warm blush and eyeshadow, red satin-finish lips, and a modest cream halter-style top with secure coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: 2:3 close-up portrait, head slightly tilted, relaxed confident gaze, one hand resting gently on cheek, minimal warm beige-and-brown background, face and glasses as focal point.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright controlled frontal beauty light emphasizing skin and hair texture, with soft studio background illumination, warm modern fashion mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm portrait lens look, hyper-detailed face texture, cinematic tone, polished editorial color grading, clean realistic hands, no magazine branding or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic 2:3 editorial close-up portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with twin high dark braids, loose strands, matte brown statement hair clips, brown cat-eye glasses, hazel eyes, natural dewy skin, warm peach blush, subtle shimmer eye makeup, red satin-finish lips, modest cream halter-style top, head slightly tilted, relaxed confident gaze, hand gently resting on cheek, warm beige-brown studio background, bright controlled frontal beauty light, 85mm lens, Korean fashion editorial mood, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, magazine text, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin

assets.name: braided glasses fashion reference

assets.usage: Match braid structure, brown glasses, hair clips, warm palette, modest top, hand-on-cheek pose, and portrait crop; keep the adult fictional identity and wardrobe details replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the hairstyle, accessories, pose, lighting, and editorial intent. Keep the fictional adult identity, outfit, and background replaceable; avoid real-person likeness, text, and branding.
